recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source work is needed unless a future editorial change reintroduces Element-page JSON examples, in which case they should match or link to `json.html#primitive`.
issue_request: FHIR-13156 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core issue against the Element page. It asked to correct an example showing primitive JSON extensions because it used `name_` instead of `_name` and `_id` instead of `id`, and suggested relying on the correct `json.html#primitive` guidance.
initial_application: The SVN-imported commit 8fac50cbd771ca6744c5c2d8fabc20c1cf8260fc, message `#13156 - fix error about json format` and git-svn build@11890, matches the Jira comment and changed the legacy `source/element.html` example from `_id` to `id`, `name_` to `_name`, and `appended` to `prepended`.
additional_context: The legacy `source/element.html` file is no longer tracked. Current `source/fhir.ini` maps `element=types`, so the Element page source is `source/types.html`; primitive JSON serialization guidance is maintained on `source/json.html`. A 2016 Zulip implementers thread identified the same prefix-versus-suffix issue and confirmed JSON starts the primitive shadow property with an underscore. Confluence searches found no conflicting record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current `source/json.html` already says `_` is prepended to the element name and shows `_birthDate` and `_family` examples with `id`; current `source/types.html` does not repeat the stale JSON example.
